subject: Novara: purchase-path checkpoint & onboarding plan
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ellis Cooper <ellis@novara.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Novara procurement check-in — post-call recap and immediate asks

Hi Ellis —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned with your buying sequence:

- Economic buyer: you mentioned the CFO is the final sign-off (Diane Park) — can you confirm contact and whether we should be coordinating a brief exec POV with her?
- Procurement path: you said procurement will own PO issuance and vendor intake. Please confirm the procurement inbox/contact and typical approval SLAs.
- Security/compliance: you flagged SOC 2 + a short vendor questionnaire. Who owns that on your side (security-ops@novara.com?) and do they prefer the questionnaire via email or a portal upload?
- Timeline: you indicated approvals in Dec and PO in mid-Dec. We noted a target for test/PO->integration early Jan. Please confirm target go-live window (your preferred date).

Attachments I've included: 
- Novara_MVP_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (checklist + docs we typically need for vendor intake)
- Redwood_SOW_draft_v1.docx (SOW stub for review; pricing section is flagged for alignment)

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Confirm economic buyer contact (name/email)
2) Confirm procurement inbox and PO cadence (approx approval dates)
3) Confirm security contact and preferred delivery for questionnaire

Suggested next step: 30-minute procurement + security kickoff next week to walk the checklist and capture any vendor intake forms. I have availability Tue 11/23 10–11am PT, Wed 11/24 11–12pm PT, or Mon 11/29 9–10am PT — happy to align to whatever works for your team.

Thanks — will await the three confirmations and preferred meeting slot.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Novara_MVP_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (staged), Redwood_SOW_draft_v1.docx (staged)
From: Ellis Cooper <ellis@novara.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novara.com, security-ops@novara.com
Date: 2026-11-18T17:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Novara procurement check-in — post-call recap and immediate asks

Hi Grace —

Appreciate the clear recap. Answers below: 

- Economic buyer: Diane Park (Diane.Park@novara.com), CFO. She wants a 1-page exec summary + cost delta vs. current workflow before a touch. If you can prepare that, great.
- Procurement contact: procurement@novara.com is our central intake (lead: Linda Rivera). Typical internal approvals are 2–3 weeks depending on committee calendar; procurement aims to issue POs within ~3 business days after final sign-off.
- Security/compliance: Tom Adebayo (tom.adebayo@novara.com) owns vendor security. They prefer the questionnaire as a PDF upload to our vendor portal (we'll provide credentials once intake is initiated).
- Timeline: Our rough internal target is to finalize commercial terms by Dec 10, PO issued by Dec 15, and integration work starting the week of Jan 4. That aligns with your Jan go-live window.

For next steps: please send the SOW and a consolidated onboarding checklist (one doc we can drop into procurement). Also provide a short billing/remittance one-pager for our AP team.

I can do Wed 11/24 11am ET (8am PT) for the procurement kickoff — I'll loop Linda and Tom on the calendar invite once we lock it.

Thanks,
Ellis Cooper
Director, Partnerships | Novara Health
ellis@novara.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Novara procurement check-in — internal next steps

Internal notes —

- Grace: I can turn the 1-page exec summary and the billing one-pager. I'll draft both by EOD tomorrow.
- Rishi: can you confirm SOC 2 artifact package and runbook we can upload? Specifically: cert, AOC, data-flow diagram, and any encryption/KMS statements. If SOC 2 is current we should be able to provide the package as a zipped upload.
- Pricing: let's keep the SOW as-is for now. If procurement asks for term options, propose 12-month annual commit with an implementation credit; we can consider a small concession for expedited PO (TBD).

I'll also draft a clean onboarding checklist that matches their portal fields so procurement can consume it quickly.

-Marissa
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Novara procurement check-in — SOW, checklist, and proposed meeting times

Ellis —

Thanks for the confirmations. Attaching the SOW draft and a single-file onboarding checklist for procurement intake. Highlights below:

- Exec summary: Marissa will send a one-pager tomorrow for Diane (CFO).
- Billing/Remittance: attached one-pager with Redwood billing address and AP contact (we'll finalize details if your AP needs a different remittance name).
- SOC 2: Rishi is preparing the artifact bundle; Rishi — once ready, should we send zipped upload to their portal or share a temporary Drive link?
- Proposed meeting: we have Wed 11/24 11am ET (8am PT) blocked as tentative. Please confirm and we'll send a calendar invite with dial-in + agenda (15-minute checklist review, 15-minute procurement portal walk).

Best,
Grace

Grace —

Confirming Wed 11/24 11am ET works for Linda (procurement) and Tom (security). Please send the calendar invite and include the following in the invite description:

- Link to the single onboarding checklist (PDF) for procurement intake
- Short agenda: 1) intake fields & docs 2) contract/timing expectations 3) next steps & who owns follow-ups

I'll wait for the invite.
